Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ibmmq

Record Class MqConnectionProfile

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.nexuslink.protocol.ibmmq.MqConnectionProfile
Record Components:
queueManager - queue manager name, e.g. QM1
channel - server-connection channel, e.g. DEV.APP.SVRCONN
host - queue manager host
port - listener port, conventionally 1414
user - MQ user id, may be null/blank for no authentication
password - password for user
tls - whether to negotiate TLS on the channel
cipherSuite - JSSE CipherSuite matching the channel's CipherSpec; required when tls
trustStore - path to a JKS/PKCS12 trust store holding the QM certificate; may be null to use the JVM default
trustStorePassword - password for trustStore
ams - whether to enable Advanced Message Security interception
amsKeystoreConf - path to the AMS keystore.conf; required when ams
public record MqConnectionProfile(String queueManager, String channel, String host, int port, String user, String password, boolean tls, String cipherSuite, String trustStore, String trustStorePassword, boolean ams, String amsKeystoreConf) extends Record
Everything needed to open a client-mode (CLIENT binding) connection to an IBM MQ queue manager: where it lives, which server-connection channel to ride, who we are, and how the channel is protected.

Two protection layers are modelled and they are independent:

  • TLS — encrypts the channel. Requires cipherSuite to name the same CipherSpec the SVRCONN channel is defined with, and a JSSE trust store holding the queue manager's certificate.
  • AMS (Advanced Message Security) — encrypts/signs the message payload end-to-end, independent of the channel. Requires a keystore.conf pointing at a key repository, and message-protection policies defined on the queue manager itself (setmqspl). The client only supplies the keystore; if the queue manager has no policy for a queue, AMS is a no-op for it.

Use plain(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) for the common dev case and with* to layer security on.
